## Purpose

Implement native-feeling animations with React View Transition API: &lt;ViewTransition&gt;, addTransitionType, shared element (name prop), directional nav, Next.js integration (transitionTypes on Link), CSS recipes (fade/slide etc), a11y prefers-reduced-motion. From vercel-labs/agent-skills.
